name: Lust ~Saiin Joutai~
source:
As one's intention of heroines who came into rut by the effect of entertainments obscene medicine. The heroine doesn't put out her hand to the hero who doesn't like violence until hoping. However, there is no pardon if the other party requests it.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090305060335/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/cPath/146_50/products_id/1001165]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
女主角們服了助興的催情藥後紛紛發情，任憑自己的心意行事。她們不會主動接近不喜歡暴力的主角，除非自己有所渴求；但如果對方主動要求，她們也絕不會手下留情。
